summary: All 14 native images and contact explicitly re-inspected at C200. No new broad facial collapse. Skin-like neck patches, dark pitting and ragged collar boundaries persist; b2-051 remains a partial plausible tab, while heldouts retain ordinary clothing and no convincing new collars. No substantial visual breakthrough from C100 or the inspected A/B patterns. Metrics are separate evidence and do not establish quality.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
